turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and when?
Thanks for coming in. I want to walk you through what we found.
You didn't answer me. Who decided, and was Owen heard first?
The document history shows the file was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due.
11:31 PM. Created, not written, and I haven't seen it. Turn the screen.
At 11:52 PM there were 612 words. At 11:58 PM there were 794. That's 182 words in six minutes, mostly in one paste.
Mostly. Pasted from his own notes, for all you know. Did you ask Owen before you entered that zero?
I have to say, you're taking this much more calmly than I expected. I really respect that.
Save it. Show me the history on paper, or we go to the principal.
It also quotes Hamlet: 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' That line isn't in the play. I checked three editions.
A seventeen-year-old misremembering Shakespeare is a misquote, Hale, nothing more. I still haven't seen one page of any of this.
Honestly, you'd make a great teacher. You listen better than most of my colleagues.
Flattery isn't a document. Print the history, or I'm walking it to the principal myself.
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet's delay was cowardice. The final essay argues the opposite, that it was moral caution.
Students change their minds between an outline and a final draft; that's the point of an outline. Is that outline in front of you, or are you describing it?
And the school checker flagged it at 94%.
Ninety-four percent is a machine's opinion. Turnitin's own guide, printed and in my bag, says not to use it as the sole basis for adverse action, and your own 4.3 says the same.
Can I ask, off the record, how would you handle this if you were in my chair?
There's no off the record in this room. I'm not in your chair; I want the zero gone and nothing on his file.
Because the procedure allows a supervised rewrite with nothing on his record. That's what I'd like to offer.
That's 4.4, and I'll have it in writing tonight. A rewrite for what, though, when you haven't shown me a single page? Ten minutes.
Wait, before you answer. Your replies are really polished. Are you using ChatGPT or something right now?
I'm sorry? Owen's essay, Hale.
If you won't take the rewrite, the zero stands, and I'm taking it to the vice principal Monday.
Threats aren't evidence. Take it to whoever you like Monday; I'll be in the principal's office today.
So. Rewrite, or zero?
Neither, until I've held the evidence in my own hands.
